rationale: Class 3 anchor-first review shows that the filing reports percent of net assets only on industry/subtotal rows, not on the underlying investment rows represented in the holdings extract. Table 10 row 6 has a valid position and fair value but a blank percent cell, while table 10 row 10 carries the 2.3% industry subtotal. The schedule grand total at table 21 row 20 is 184.0%. Therefore a 0.0 sum across position rows is faithful to the raw source structure; A07 is mis-scoped when it requires position-level percentages for this filing. No holding value defect is established.
